name: Suzhou W Deane New Power Elec
summary: Suzhou West Deane New Power Electric Co., Ltd., based in Suzhou, China, is an enterprise focused on the entire process of electrical connection product development. This encompasses research, design, production, and market distribution. Their specialized offerings include cutting-edge battery connection systems and composite busbars. The company was co-founded by Shu Xin Pan and Jian Hua Sheng on May 31, 2007.
